title: P7 is authorized: the eight-slice ladder of #223 §42 is delivered back to back without waiting for self-hosted runners
problem: P7 (Dynamic Parameters / Schema Runtime) held one placeholder slice, P7-S01, marked 'not authorized; requires a Manager Master Prompt', and #223 is planning only. The owner asked in chat on 2026-09-26 to work P7 as a marathon without the self-hosted runners. The ladder needs canonical slice ids, a feature-to-slice mapping and an explicit statement of how the runner instruction relates to DEC-0015.

options.summary: Split P7 into P7-S01..P7-S08, one slice per #223 §42 rung (P7.1..P7.8 become Pn-Snn ids; no new P numbers). Map the 29 P7 features onto them. Deliver them back to back, one delivery PR per slice (DEC-0014). Merge on GitHub-hosted green with self-hosted checks green or WAITING_RUNNER (DEC-0015 model B), never waiting on the self-hosted fleet; a slice whose self-hosted checks have not passed stays in-progress (VERIFYING) and only becomes implemented when DEC-0015 holds.
Deliver all of P7 as one slice P7-S01.
Count hosted-green merges as implemented without self-hosted verification.

rationale: Owner instruction in chat on 2026-09-26: 'kerjakan p7 maraton tanpa Runner selfhosted' (work P7 as a marathon without the self-hosted runners). Option A follows the ladder #223 already proposes and keeps each slice reviewable. B would be one unreviewable PR and breaks the per-rung acceptance of #223. C would contradict DEC-0015 and rule 12 (WAITING_RUNNER is never PASS), which this decision does not change: 'without the self-hosted runners' means delivery never waits for them, not that their verification is presumed. P7 keeps its #223 §43 hard boundaries: it is not a workflow engine, expression rewrite, credential manager, storage engine, node runtime or plugin admission system. No CI workflow, runner or compiler configuration is touched (owner runner/CI mandate).
